display

(noun). sự phô bày, sự trưng bày

Ex: She slammed the door behind her in a display of ill-temper.

involve

(verb). liên quan, bao hàm

Ex: The test will involve answering questions about a photograph.

emphasise

(verb). Nhấn mạnh

Ex: His speech emphasised the importance of attracting industry to the town.

origin

(noun). Nguồn gốc

Ex: This particular custom has its origins in Wales.

rely

(verb). dựa trên, dựa vào

Ex: They had to rely entirely on volunteer workers.

reflect

(verb). phản ánh, cho thấy bản chất của

Ex: Our newspaper aims to reflect the views of the local community.

minority

(noun). phần thiểu số

Ex: For a minority, the decision was a disappointment.

taste

(noun). khẩu vị

Ex: You can adapt the recipe to suit your personal taste.

partnership

(noun). Quan hệ hợp tác

Ex: He developed his own program in partnership with an American expert.

separate

(adjective). riêng biệt, khác nhau

Ex: It happened on three separate occasions.

identity

(noun). cá tính, đặc tính, nét nhận dạng

Ex: The region's sense of identity remained strong.

distinguish

(verb). phân biệt

Ex: At what age are children able to distinguish between right and wrong?

expert

(noun). Chuyên gia

Ex: According to our panel of leading industry experts, a downturn is inevitable.

demand

(noun). sự đòi hỏi, sự yêu cầu

Ex: Teacher training has to evolve to meet the changing demands of the profession.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

income

(noun). Thu nhập

Ex: Tourism is a major source of income for the area.

generate

(verb). tạo ra, phát ra

Ex: We need someone to generate new ideas.

pursue

(verb). Theo đuổi

Ex: She wishes to pursue a medical career.

objective

(noun). Mục tiêu, mục đích

Ex: The main objective of this meeting is to give more information on our plans.

certain

(adjective). nhất định, nào đó

Ex: You can choose to only watch certain kinds of movies.

constraint

(noun). sự hạn chế

Ex: This decision will impose serious constraints on all schools.

conflicting

(adjective). đối lập, mâu thuẫn

Ex: The jury heard conflicting evidence from three different witnesses.

priority

(noun). sự ưu tiên

Ex: Education is a top priority.

assumption

(noun). Sự phỏng đoán, giả định

Ex: It was impossible to make assumptions about people's reactions.

reveal

(verb). Tiết lộ

Ex: The survey reveals some worrying statistics.

allow

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This research must be allowed to continue.

contemporary

(adjective). đương thời

Ex: He is among the best-known contemporary artists.

note

(verb). chú ý, nhận thấy

Ex: It should be noted that dissertations submitted late will not be accepted.

durable

(adjective). Bền bỉ

Ex: Painted steel is likely to be less durable than other kinds.

tend

(verb). có xu hướng

Ex: People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.

ignore

(verb). Bỏ qua; làm lơ

Ex: I made a suggestion but they chose to ignore it.

displease

(verb). àm phật lòng, làm trái ý, làm bực mình

Ex: I wouldn't want to do anything to displease him.

focus

(verb). tập trung

Ex: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.

inevitable

(adjective). Không thể tránh khỏi

Ex: They came to see defeat as inevitable.

representation

(noun). sự thể hiện, sự trình bày

Ex: The film offers a realistic representation of life in rural Spain.

transitory

(adjective). tạm thời, chốc lát; nhất thời

Ex: These feelings of resentment tend to be transitory.

nature

(noun). bản chất

Ex: His work explores the nature of the mother-child relationship.

material

(noun). Chất liệu

Ex: We have 98% of the same genetic material as chimpanzees.

survive

(verb). Sống sót, tồn tại

Ex: They spent two months in the jungle, surviving on small animals and fruit.

consumer

(noun). Người tiêu dùng

Ex: Health-conscious consumers want more information about the food they buy.

avoid

(verb). tránh

Ex: We must find a way to avoid similar problems in future.

boundary

(noun). ranh giới

Ex: The fence marks the boundary between my property and hers.

occupy

(verb). chiếm đóng, cư ngụ

Ex: Protesting students occupied the university office for two weeks.

approximately

(adverb). xấp xỉ

Ex: The journey took approximately seven hours.

inhabitant

(noun). Cư dân

Ex: It is a town of about 10 000 inhabitants.

conviction

(noun). Sự tin chắc; sức thuyết phục; niềm tin

Ex: She was motivated by deep religious conviction.

infallible

(adjective). không thể sai, không thể hỏng

Ex: Even the experts are not infallible.

testimony

(noun). lời chứng, lời khai

Ex: Her claim was supported by the testimony of several witnesses.

root

(verb). có gốc rễ ở

Ex: Vegetarianism is rooted in Indian culture.

regard

(verb). Đánh giá

Ex: They regarded people outside their own town with suspicion.

observe

(verb). Quan sát

Ex: I want you to observe all the details.

evident

(adjective). Hiển nhiên

Ex: It has now become evident to us that a mistake has been made.

chronicle

(noun). sử biên niên; ký sự niên đại; ghi chép (những sự kiện...)

Ex: Her latest novel is a chronicle of life in a Devon village.

faith

(noun). niềm tin

Ex: We've lost faith in the government's promises.

veracity

(noun). tính chính xác, sự đáng tin

Ex: They questioned the veracity of her story.

tangible

(adjective). Hữu hình, xác thực, rõ ràng

Ex: We cannot accept his findings without tangible evidence.

relic

(noun). di tích, di vật

Ex: The pictures on the walls were relics from the days before her marriage.

explanation

(noun). giải thích

Ex: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

exclusive

(adjective). độc chiếm, độc quyền

Ex: The hotel has exclusive access to the beach.

domain

(noun). phạm vi, lĩnh vực

Ex: Financial matters are her domain.

scientific

(adjective). thuộc về khoa học

Ex: The book lacks any sound scientific basis.

researcher

(noun). Nhà nghiên cứu

Ex: Researchers found there was no evidence of an increased risk of infection.

prototype

(noun). Bản mẫu

Ex: Scientists have developed a working prototype for the machine.

so-called

(adjective). Được gọi là

Ex: How have these so-called improvements helped the local community?

virtual

(adjective). ảo

Ex: You can also take a virtual tour of the museum.

vivid

(adjective). Sống động

Ex: He gave a vivid account of his life as a fighter pilot.

period

(noun). kỳ, thời kỳ

Ex: The project will run for a six-month trial period.

intolerable

(adjective). không thể chịu đựng nổi, quá quắt

Ex: Her behaviour has become intolerable.

vulgarisation

(noun). sự thông tục hoá, sự tầm thường hoá

Ex: This vulgarization of Christmas is a totally unacceptable intrusion by the non-Christian majority.

related

(adjective). liên quan

Ex: These problems are closely related.

concept

(noun). khái niệm, ý tưởng

Ex: Students must be able to apply classroom concepts to practical situations.

authenticity

(noun). tính xác thực

Ex: There has been some debate over the authenticity of his will.

enormous

(adjective). Khổng lồ

Ex: Universities are under enormous pressure financially.

jungle

(noun). rừng

Ex: The area was covered in dense jungle.

distinct

(adjective). khác biệt

Ex: The results of the survey fell into two distinct groups.

fulfil

(verb). hiện thực hóa, làm tròn

Ex: The building is still fulfilling its original purpose admirably.

asset

(noun). Tài sản

Ex: Her assets include shares in the company and a house in France.

dominant

(adjective). chiếm ưu thế

Ex: The firm has achieved a dominant position in the world market.

misconception

(noun). sự hiểu sai

Ex: Their views are based on misconception and prejudice.

prejudice

(noun). Thành kiến

Ex: Their decision was based on ignorance and prejudice.

lifespan

(noun). tuổi thọ

Ex: Worms have a lifespan of a few months.

dwelling

(noun). chỗ ở, nhà ở

Ex: There is an estimated shortfall of some five million dwellings across the country.

premise

(noun). tiền đề

Ex: His reasoning is based on the premise that all people are equally capable of good and evil.

circumstance

(noun). Hoàn cảnh, tình huống

Ex: I know I can trust her in any circumstance.

era

(noun). Thời đại; Kỷ nguyên

Ex: This is the start of a new era of peace and prosperity.

stroll

(verb). đi dạo, đi tản bộ

Ex: People were strolling along the beach.

nostalgia

(noun). nỗi luyến tiếc quá khứ, nỗi nhớ

Ex: She is filled with nostalgia for her own college days.

indicate

(verb). chỉ ra, hiển thị

Ex: The survey data indicate a general satisfaction with the process.

notion

(noun). khái niệm

Ex: She had only a vague notion of what might happen.

induce

(verb). gây ra

Ex: Hearing loss is often induced by exposure to loud noise.
